articles.headline: Hannah Hidalgo becomes all-time leading scorer for Notre Dame women's hoops
articles.description: Hannah Hidalgo had 22 points and nine steals as she became Notre Dame's all-time leading scorer during the 13th-ranked Fighting Irish's 78-64 win over No. 22 West Virginia at the Battle 4 Atlantis.

images.name: 260329 Hidalgo [1296x729]
images.caption: Notre Dame guard Hannah Hidalgo, who had 22 points and 11 rebounds in Sunday's loss to UConn, ranked third nationally with 25.3 points per game and became the first player in Division I with 200 steals in a season, finishing with 202.

images.name: TV Show Rankings [1296x518]
images.caption: A Seton Hall Sports Poll found that Friday Night Lights edged Ted Lasso by one percentage point among Americans asked to name their favorite sports TV shows of the 21st century.
